_comment: Hand-authored overlay for KIAD, merged over the surface geometry.
Unlike KATL there is no committed schematic: Dulles gate numbering is not something
to guess at, so stand ids, positions and headings all come from the OpenStreetMap
surface, which the page fetches and caches on first visit. Export it and commit it as
data/ramp/KIAD.osm.json to remove the fetch for everyone.
This file carries only what no machine-readable source publishes: the concourse
grouping, the ramp areas and the airline blocks.
UNVERIFIED — compiled from public terminal guides, August 2026.
